class.name: SmokeServer
class.brief_description: The particle emitters of the world, by RID.
class.description: Smoke a vehicle or the scenery gives off. An emitter is made of a [SmokeSource] and drawn with a sprite - by default the flipbook of [code]reloaded/smoke/modern/atlas[/code], the core's own smoke. A moving emitter ([constant KIND_DYNAMIC]) spawns its particles at the rate its owner sets ([method smoke_set_intensity]); a standing one ([constant KIND_STATIC]) emits on its own, its plume in the air the moment it is built. Every emitter drifts with the wind of [SimulationServer]. A change of a [code]reloaded/smoke/*[/code] setting builds every emitter again.

method.name: smoke_create
method.description: An emitter built as soon as it has a source.

method.name: smoke_free
method.description: [param emitter] freed with its particles and its registration in [SceneryStreamingServer].

method.name: smoke_get_atlas
method.description: The flipbook of [code]reloaded/smoke/modern/atlas[/code]; null when the project gives none.

method.name: smoke_get_density
method.description: How many more particles an emitter of [param kind] gives than its source asks for; each is fainter by as much.

method.name: smoke_get_lifetime
method.description: How long a particle of [param source] lives in an emitter of [param kind] [lb]s[rb].

method.name: smoke_get_max_particles
method.description: The particles one emitter of [param kind] holds at most.

method.name: smoke_get_statistics
method.description: The number of emitters ([code]total[/code]) and how many of them are built now ([code]built[/code]). A registered emitter is built only while the camera is near.

method.name: smoke_register
method.description: An emitter standing at [param transform], built while the camera is within its kind's distance ([code]reloaded/smoke/dynamic/distance[/code], [code]reloaded/smoke/static/distance[/code]).

method.name: smoke_set_intensity
method.description: A moving emitter's spawn rate over its source's, 0..1. Only the rate: nothing reaches a particle already in the air.

method.name: smoke_set_scenario
method.description: The world [param emitter] is drawn in; an empty RID draws it nowhere.

method.name: smoke_set_source
method.description: What the emitter is made of; it is built of it again.

method.name: smoke_set_sprite
method.description: What a particle is drawn with; null for the core's own smoke.

method.name: smoke_set_transform
method.description: Where the particles are born; they leave along the transform's up axis.

constants.constant: An emitter of the scenery, standing still.
A vehicle's emitter, moving and spawning at the rate its owner sets.
